title: Comparison maps of minimal free models are isomorphisms after reduction
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a local ring. Let $K\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex], and let $C_0^\bullet$ be the bounded above finite free representative selected by its pseudo-coherence witness. Put $d_i=\dim_\kappa H^i(C_0^\bullet\otimes_R\kappa)$. Let $F^\bullet,G^\bullet$ be bounded above complexes representing $K$, with $F^i\cong G^i\cong R^{\oplus d_i}$ for every $i$. Then there is a chain map $\beta:F^\bullet\to G^\bullet$ such that each $\beta^i\otimes_R\kappa$ is an isomorphism of $\kappa$-modules.

source.place: Tag 0BCC, lemma-lift-pseudo-coherent-from-residue-field; proof checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BCC (current numbering Lemma 15.77.6)

proof.text: Every bounded above free representative is K-projective. Apply [lem-pc-ring-derived-map-representative] in both directions and use injectivity to show the composites are identities in the homotopy category. HomotopyCategory.homotopyEquivOfIso gives homotopy equivalences between $C_0$ and either representative, and between $F$ and $G$.

Extension of scalars is additive by its adjunction with restriction of scalars. Functor.mapHomotopyEquiv therefore transports all these homotopy equivalences to the residue field; they induce homology isomorphisms. TensorProduct finite base change and finrank_baseChange give finite terms of dimension $d_i$ in the reduced representatives.

For a complex $C$ over a field with finite terms, the cycle inclusion is injective and the homology projection is surjective, so $\dim H^i(C)\leq\dim Z^i(C)\leq\dim C^i$. Equality of the outside dimensions makes the cycle inclusion surjective by LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank. Cancel this epimorphism in $iCycles\gg d=0$ to show every differential is zero. Apply this to both reductions.

The reduced comparison from the homotopy equivalence is a quasi-isomorphism. With all differentials zero, the cycle inclusions and homology projections are isomorphisms. Their naturality identifies each comparison component with an isomorphism on homology, so it is an isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: Lean realization of the proof of Stacks Tag 0BCC; the source was read on the official Stacks website. The detailed projectivity, dimension and Nakayama glue is expanded by the worker.
